graph_diagnosis.summary: Consumer spending, inflation, frugality, and economic uncertainty provide limited reusable retail-demand context.
weaknesses: All earnings, guidance, realized-revenue, and option links are excluded; post-cutoff earnings anchors are provenance only.
The graph has no supported mix, inventory, competitive, or e-commerce driver.
The target bridge is weak and requires current consumer, pricing, mix, inventory, competition, and online-sales verification.

search_factors.why_search: Inflation can shift households toward essentials and value channels.
Inflation concerns can signal continued pressure on household budgets.

checkpoints.mechanism: Persistent inflation can shift households toward value and essential purchases.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Inflation and category spending data confirm the shift.

checkpoints.mechanism: Strong aggregate spending can support retail demand, subject to category mix.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Spending breadth and retailer category data agree.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Spending is concentrated outside retail categories.

checkpoints.mechanism: Economic uncertainty can restrain discretionary spending and planning.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Consumer confidence and discretionary categories weaken.

checkpoints.mechanism: Renewed inflation concern can pressure household budgets and sentiment.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Inflation expectations and consumer prices rise together.

checkpoints.factor: Consumer demand into retail revenue growth
checkpoints.mechanism: Consumer spending, inflation-driven mix, uncertainty, inventory, competition, and online demand combine to determine retail revenue-growth acceleration.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Verify current consumer spending, inflation, category mix, inventories, competitive pricing, and online sales.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Company revenue diverges from current retail drivers.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Inflation can change retail mix while aggregate spending supports demand.
applicability_conditions: Value and essentials demand is verified.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Uncertainty and inflation concern can restrain discretionary demand.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Value-channel mix offsets weaker discretionary demand.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Compare category mix and price gaps with consumer spending.

forecast_audit_questions: Is inflation shifting mix toward essentials?
Are confidence and discretionary categories weakening?
Do inventory, competition, and online sales corroborate demand?
